status: Resolves Erdős's superexponential-growth question for van der Waerden numbers. status: Proves that full static boundary displacement-to-traction data determine both smooth real Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ3, provided μ > 0 and $`3\lambda+2\mu\gt 0`$ on the closure. Neither analyticity, proximity to constant coefficients nor prior knowledge near the boundary is required. ([Lean](lean/docs/372.md)) Manuscript dates: September 24, 2026. title: OAI family 373: Nonattainment of the three-marginal Coulomb Monge problem
open: what remains open beyond the claimed result (full generality, verification of the claim, unformalized parts), and the original open problem's remaining scope
status: An optimal three-particle Coulomb configuration need not be a deterministic function of the first particle, even for smooth identical spatial densities. The Monge and Kantorovich infima agree, but the Monge infimum is not attained. The same phenomenon occurs for every inverse-power Riesz exponent in each dimension at least two, with a suitable density in each case. ([Lean](lean/docs/373.md)) Manuscript dates: September 25, 2026. Verification status varies; treat as model-produced claim pending community review.

title: OAI family 374: Sharp one-third stability of Brenier maps
open: what remains open beyond the claimed result (full generality, verification of the claim, unformalized parts), and the original open problem's remaining scope
status: For uniform source measure ρ on a compact convex body with interior in dimension at least two, quadratic optimal transport maps satisfy $`\|T_\mu-T_\nu\|_{L^2(\rho)}\le C W_2(\mu,\nu)^{1/3}`$ uniformly over targets in a fixed compact set. The exponent is sharp, even for three-atom targets, disproving Letrouit's conjectured square-root bound. ([Lean](lean/docs/374.md)) Manuscript dates: September 25, 2026. Verification status varies; treat as model-produced claim pending community review.

title: OAI family 375: De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight
open: what remains open beyond the claimed result (full generality, verification of the claim, unformalized parts), and the original open problem's remaining scope
status: Proves De Giorgi's conjecture at its sharp dimension-eight endpoint: every entire C2 solution $`u:\mathbb R^8\to(-1,1)`$ of $`\Delta u=u^3-u`$ that is strictly increasing in one direction depends on only one linear coordinate. A stronger theorem classifies all stable entire solutions $`v:\mathbb R^7\to[-1,1]`$ as constant wells or planar transitions, without an energy-growth assumption. Manuscript dates: September 26, 2026. Verification status varies; treat as model-produced claim pending community review.

title: OAI family 376: Universal computation in forced Navier–Stokes flows
open: what remains open beyond the claimed result (full generality, verification of the claim, unformalized parts), and the original open problem's remaining scope
status: Constructs viscous incompressible flows starting from rest on a fixed flat three-dimensional domain that perform universal computation under smooth external forcing. A terminating compiler turns a Turing machine and input into a finite program for the force, so a designated particle reaches a fixed region exactly when the machine halts. The viscosity is fixed, positive and computable. ([Lean](lean/docs/376.md)) Manuscript dates: September 27, 2026. Verification status varies; treat as model-produced claim pending community review.

title: OAI family 377: Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ regularity for infinity-harmonic functions
open: what remains open beyond the claimed result (full generality, verification of the claim, unformalized parts), and the original open problem's remaining scope
status: Proves uniform interior $`C^{1,\alpha_d}`$ regularity for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension d ≥ 3, for a positive exponent depending only on dimension. The gradient's supremum norm and Hölder seminorm on the half unit ball are bounded by a dimension-dependent constant times the oscillation on the unit ball. The exponent is not explicit. Manuscript dates: October 4, 2026. Verification status varies; treat as model-produced claim pending community review.
